name: Star Chroma
author: toasty-wheeler
description: Razer Chroma lighting for Starsector. Campaign: ability keys 1-0 glow light blue when ready and red while in use or cooling down; Tab, E, C, D, F, R, I, F2 (codex), F4 and F5 (quicksave/quickload) glow light blue. Combat: everything goes white, shields fill blue from the bottom up, flux heats the lights to red-orange, hull damage slowly fades keys to black, blinks some red/orange and shuts more off, low crew readiness blinks the keyboard and mousepad outline yellow or red, ship systems (F) get their own effects (burn streaks, teleport collapse and burst, phase shimmer, ammo-feed belts), and losing your flagship sets off an explosion. Needs Razer Synapse / Razer Chroma app running. Safe to add or remove at any time.
